title: Gotsman–Linial extremizer
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$, the Gotsman–Linial extremizer is the Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube that sends each input $x$ to the sign of the Gotsman–Linial cube polynomial evaluated at $x$.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not define the cube polynomial or the threshold-sign operation, so their meanings cannot be made more explicit.
